traits.label: Hymenium
traits.text: Features a smooth, white to cream underside where the spores are produced, unique among polypores for being soft and leathery rather than hard or woody.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium: Features a smooth, white to cream underside where the spores are produced, unique among polypores for being soft and leathery rather than hard or woody.

traits.label: Cap
traits.text: 5-15 cm in diameter. Flat to slightly convex, soft, and typically pale to medium orange or salmon pink, with a velvety to slightly fuzzy texture.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Cap: 5-15 cm in diameter. Flat to slightly convex, soft, and typically pale to medium orange or salmon pink, with a velvety to slightly fuzzy texture.

traits.label: Hymenium Attachment
traits.text: Attached directly to the wood substrate, often appearing as a lateral extension with no distinct stipe.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium Attachment: Attached directly to the wood substrate, often appearing as a lateral extension with no distinct stipe.

traits.label: Stipe
traits.text: Absent or rudimentary, not distinct from the cap.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Stipe: Absent or rudimentary, not distinct from the cap.

traits.label: Description
traits.text: Spore pring is white.
traits.raw: ⚪ Spore pring is white.

traits.label: Ecology
traits.text: Saprobic, growing exclusively on dead or dying wood of mapple trees (Acer spp.).
traits.raw: 🪵 Saprobic, growing exclusively on dead or dying wood of mapple trees (Acer spp.).

traits.label: Edibility
traits.text: Inedible due to its tough and leathery texture.
traits.raw: 😣 Inedible due to its tough and leathery texture.

traits.label: Fruit body
traits.text: Typically 5-15 cm across and 1-3 cm thick.
traits.raw: 📏 Typically 5-15 cm across and 1-3 cm thick.

traits.label: Microscopy
traits.text: Spores are cylindrical to allantoid, smooth, 3-5 x 1-1.5 µm.
traits.raw: 🔬 Spores are cylindrical to allantoid, smooth, 3-5 x 1-1.5 µm.

traits.label: Odour
traits.text: Mild or not distinctive.
traits.raw: 👃 Mild or not distinctive.

traits.label: Overview
traits.text: Notable for its association with mapple trees and its unique soft, leathery texture that sets it apart from many other polypores.
traits.raw: 🔤 Notable for its association with mapple trees and its unique soft, leathery texture that sets it apart from many other polypores.
